title: Google releases Gemini 4 Argon, called its most powerful model yet
summary: Google has released its latest Gemini model, marketing it as a workhorse for coding and cybersecurity work.
title_es: Google lanza Gemini 4 Argon, su modelo más potente
bajada: Google presentó Gemini 4 Argon, diseñado específicamente para ingeniería de software, ciberseguridad y trabajo empresarial. El acceso inicial está limitado a defensores de ciberseguridad de confianza, indicando una estrategia de lanzamiento controlada para un modelo de frontera.
bajada_en: Google unveiled Gemini 4 Argon, designed specifically for software engineering, cybersecurity, and enterprise work. Initial access is limited to trusted cyber defenders, signaling a controlled rollout strategy for a frontier-class model.

The new model delivers "frontier performance in complex workflows across real-world software engineering, enterprise knowledge work like legal and finance, and cybersecurity defense," according to chief AI architect and Google DeepMind SVP Koray Kavukcuoglu. But the company is limiting access at […]
title_es: OpenAI presenta GPT-6.1 Sol con rendimiento cercano a Astra
bajada: OpenAI lanzó GPT-6.1 Sol, un modelo que ofrece rendimiento cercano a su modelo Astra pero a un quinto del costo. Este lanzamiento enfatiza la estrategia de OpenAI de democratizar acceso a modelos potentes mediante opciones más económicas.
bajada_en: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Sol, a model delivering near-Astra performance at a fifth of the price. This launch underscores OpenAI's strategy to democratize access to powerful models through more cost-effective options.

title: GPT 6.1 Sol: Near-Astra intelligence for a fifth of the price
title_es: ElevenLabs duplica valoración a $22 mil millones
bajada: La startup de síntesis de voz ElevenLabs alcanzó una valoración de $22 mil millones tras una ronda de tender de $300 millones liderada por Wellington y T. Rowe Price. El hito refleja la creciente importancia de la tecnología de voz en la IA.
bajada_en: Voice synthesis startup ElevenLabs reached a $22 billion valuation following a $300 million tender round led by Wellington and T. Rowe Price. The milestone reflects growing importance of voice technology in AI.

bajada_en: Flow Engineering, a startup bringing AI agents to hardware design, closed a $750M round backed by Valor, Atreides, and Sequoia. The funding underscores interest in applying AI to complex technical processes.

bajada: NVIDIA y CoreWeave anunciaron su colaboración para llevar infraestructura de IA agentic a producción, aprovechando años de co-engineering. La iniciativa muestra el movimiento de la industria hacia sistemas de IA autónomos en entornos reales.

title_es: OpenAI expone campaña de destilación coordinada contra sus modelos
bajada: OpenAI reveló cómo desactivó una campaña coordinada para extraer razonamiento protegido de sus modelos y anunció fortalecimiento de defensas contra destilación adversarial. El incidente subraya los desafíos de seguridad en modelos frontera.
bajada_en: OpenAI revealed how it disrupted a coordinated campaign to extract protected reasoning from its models and announced strengthened defenses against adversarial distillation. The incident underscores security challenges facing frontier models.

title: Why DoorDash Needs Its Own AI Assistant
summary: Tech companies may have already perfected the art of separating consumers from their money—but AI promises to take that capability to a whole new level. The latest demonstration of that is DoorDash’s Wednesdayannouncementthat customers will soon be able to order restaurant meals and groceries by text. The new service is a result of DoorDash integrating the capabilities of its AI assistant, which is already in its app, into iMessage.So if you’re like me and you like to reorder the same restaurant meal every Friday night, now you can do so with a quick text. To be honest, the convenience of this seems illusory, as DoorDash’s mobile app already makes reordering a meal as easy as pie. But the AI assistant, whether it’s in the app or outside it, is an advance. If its a chore to figure out where to order food for a special dinner from, it can suggest places. The assistant is even more handy for groceries: It can list the ingredients you need for a meal and order them.
title_es: Ingresos de Micron se quintuplicaron gracias a demanda de IA
bajada: Micron reportó que sus ingresos se quintuplicaron a $54.2 mil millones en el trimestre que cierra el 3 de septiembre, impulsados por demanda de memoria de alto ancho de banda para chips de IA. El crecimiento evidencia la explosión del hardware de IA.
bajada_en: Micron reported revenue nearly quintupled to $54.2 billion in the quarter ending Sept. 3, driven by demand for high-bandwidth memory for AI chips. The growth evidences the explosive AI hardware market.

bajada_en: Reddit announced it will end RSS feed support and public API access to control AI model training on site content. The decision reflects tensions between content creators and model training practices.

title_es: Hugging Face lanza Open TTS Leaderboard multilíngüe
bajada: Hugging Face presentó Open TTS Leaderboard, un sistema escalable de evaluación para síntesis de voz y clonación de voz en múltiples idiomas. La herramienta democratiza la evaluación de modelos de texto a voz.

title_es: Disputa entre Factory y Cognition por contratación de ejecutivo
bajada: Un conflicto público entre startups de IA Cognition y Factory por la contratación de un líder de ventas evidencia la intensificación de la guerra por talento más allá de investigadores. La disputa también divisó a inversores dentro de la misma firma de VC.
bajada_en: A public feud between AI startups Cognition and Factory over hiring a sales executive reveals the intensification of talent wars beyond researchers. The dispute also divided investors within the same VC firm.

title: Behind Factory Founder’s Spat With Cognition Over Key Hire
summary: A dispute over high-flying AI coding firm Cognition’s hiring of a prominent sales leader who had advised rival Factory erupted into a public feud, dividing startups as well as investors within the same venture firm.Spats between competing startups and their investors flare up every so often in Silicon Valley. Even by those standards, Wednesday’s brawl stood out—exposing how the fight over AI talent has spilled beyond top researchers into other key jobs, and underscoring that a long-standing taboo against VC firms backing rivals still has its adherents.
title_es: DoorDash integra asistente IA para pedidos por iMessage
